nodes.label: NewEra Logo (Light Theme)
nodes.description: Light-theme variant of the NewEra365 brand logo. Displays 'NEWERA' wordmark in bold black uppercase text with a green bar chart icon to the left of the text, representing the brand identity for the forex/CFD broker website. Used on light-background contexts.

nodes.label: NewEra Green Bar Chart Icon
nodes.description: Small green bar/column chart icon positioned to the left of the 'NEWERA' wordmark in the light logo. Likely represents trading/financial growth motif for the brand.
